editorial:
Imagine heading to a quiet, remote village for a college project, thinking you'll just help the locals and get a good grade. That is exactly what happens to these six students, but things go south fast. You'll feel the tension build as they realize the village is not as peaceful as it looks. The vibe is creepy from the start, mixing a sense of curiosity with a feeling that something is watching them from the shadows. It is the kind of story where you keep telling the characters to leave, but they stay just long enough for things to get really scary.

What really works here is how the mystery unfolds. The acting feels real, and the jump scares actually land because the movie builds up the dread so well. While some parts of the plot move a bit slowly in the middle, the wild twist at the end makes it all worth it. If you enjoy folk horror, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the students are not just unlucky; they are trapped in a cycle. You find out that one student broke a sacred rule, which woke up a vengeful spirit. In the final scenes, the mysterious dancer claims the souls of those who sinned. Most of the group doesn't make it out alive, as the curse cleanses the village. It ends with a dark realization that the village's secrets are far deadlier than any school project.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves spooky village stories and unexpected twists.
